_about: Hand-written sample missions used in Demo Mode (no AI). Checkpoint timing is stored as a fraction of the outing and scaled to the chosen duration. These are labelled 'Demo Mode — local sample missions' in the UI and are never presented as AI output.

missions.title: The Campus Explorer
missions.summary: An easy-going loop that turns a familiar route into a scavenger hunt for details you usually run past.
missions.warmup: 5 minutes of easy jogging, shoulders loose
missions.pre_run_tip: Leave the earphones in your pocket for the first checkpoint. You'll notice more.

checkpoints.title: First Discovery
checkpoints.instruction: Spot something on this route you have genuinely never noticed before: a sign, a door, a tree.

checkpoints.title: Speed Burst
checkpoints.instruction: Pick a landmark ahead and run a little faster until you reach it, about 60 seconds.

checkpoints.title: Different Path
checkpoints.instruction: At the next safe junction, take the public path you normally skip for about 300 metres.

checkpoints.title: Sound Map
checkpoints.instruction: Slow down for one minute and count how many different sounds you can hear.

missions.cooldown: 5 minutes of walking and slow breathing
missions.screen_off_message: Your mission is ready. Lock your phone and go find something new.

missions.title: Leaf Hunter
missions.summary: A gentle nature walk built around looking closely at the green things around you.
missions.warmup: 3 minutes of slow walking, rolling the shoulders
missions.pre_run_tip: Walk at a pace where you could hum a song comfortably.

checkpoints.title: Three Leaves
checkpoints.instruction: Find three trees or plants with noticeably different leaf shapes.

checkpoints.title: Sky Check
checkpoints.instruction: Stop somewhere safe, look up for 30 seconds and notice the clouds or the light.

checkpoints.title: Colour Count
checkpoints.instruction: Spot five different natural colours: bark, flowers, soil, moss, sky.

missions.cooldown: 3 minutes of easy walking and a long stretch
missions.screen_off_message: Nothing on this screen is greener than what's outside. Lock it and go.

missions.title: Interval Quest
missions.summary: A focused out-and-back with short efforts that leave you proud, not wrecked.
missions.warmup: 6 minutes of easy jogging plus 4 short strides
missions.pre_run_tip: Hard sections should feel like 7 out of 10, not an all-out sprint.

checkpoints.title: Effort One
checkpoints.instruction: Run strong for 45 seconds, then jog easy until your breathing settles.

checkpoints.title: Effort Two
checkpoints.instruction: Another 60 seconds at a strong pace. Stay tall and keep your arms relaxed.

checkpoints.title: Turnaround Wave
checkpoints.instruction: At the turnaround, give a nod or a wave to the next runner or walker you see.

checkpoints.title: Final Push
checkpoints.instruction: Pick a landmark and finish your last 90 seconds faster than you started.

missions.cooldown: 5 minutes of walking, then calf and hamstring stretches
missions.screen_off_message: The plan is in your head now. Lock the phone and go earn it.

missions.title: Clear Head Loop
missions.summary: A calm loop designed to leave your thoughts somewhere behind you on the path.
missions.warmup: 4 minutes of easy movement, breathing in for 4 steps and out for 4
missions.pre_run_tip: No pace goals today. Comfortable is perfect.

checkpoints.title: Footstep Focus
checkpoints.instruction: For two minutes, focus only on the rhythm of your feet.

checkpoints.title: Small Kindness
checkpoints.instruction: Smile at the next person you pass. That's it.

checkpoints.title: Notice Three
checkpoints.instruction: Name three things you can see, two you can hear, one you can smell.

missions.cooldown: 4 minutes of slow walking and one big stretch
missions.screen_off_message: Your head will be clearer in a few minutes. Lock the phone and go.

missions.title: Neighbourhood Safari
missions.summary: A wandering route that treats your own streets like somewhere you've just arrived.
missions.pre_run_tip: Stick to footpaths and public parks; cross only at proper crossings.

checkpoints.title: Bird Spotter
checkpoints.instruction: Find a bird and watch it for ten seconds. What is it doing?

checkpoints.title: New Street
checkpoints.instruction: Turn onto a safe public street or path you have never walked before.

checkpoints.title: Oldest Thing
checkpoints.instruction: Spot the oldest-looking building, tree or wall on your route.

checkpoints.title: Strong Finish
checkpoints.instruction: Pick up the pace for the last stretch home, about one minute.

missions.screen_off_message: Your neighbourhood has stories. Lock the phone and go read them.
